voiceSummary: Deepak Builders and Engineers India Limited filed the Monitoring Agency Report issued by Crisil Ratings Limited regarding the utilization of proceeds from its Initial Public Offer for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. The report confirms that the net proceeds of Rs 1,962.21 million were fully utilized. Specifically, Rs 300.00 million was applied to the repayment or prepayment of borrowings, Rs 1,119.56 million funded working capital requirements, and Rs 542.65 million was used for general corporate purposes. The gross proceeds totaled Rs 2,172.10 million. The company states that there were no deviations from the objects disclosed in the Offer Document. The information has been made available on the company website at www.deepakbuilders.co.in.

attchmntText: Deepak Builders & Engineers India Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Deepak Builders and Engineers India Limited announced the outcome of its Board Meeting held on 12th November 2026. The Board approved the unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026. Revenue from operations was 9805.88 Lakhs for the quarter and 18791.44 Lakhs for the half year. Profit for the period was 716.89 Lakhs for the quarter and 1004.72 Lakhs for the half year. Earnings per share stood at 0.16 for the quarter and 0.22 for the half year. The company also approved the Monitoring Agency Report and the statement of deviation for the quarter ended 30th September 2026. The trading window will re-open after 48 hours of this announcement.
